$comment: Expected deviations of the fixture messages (src/fixtures.test.ts). Every message of fixtures/generated/*.hl7 and of fixtures/external/<source>/** must parse with parse() and encode back to the same wire text unless a record here says otherwise: `error` is a substring of the expected parse error, `dropped` lists the segments the structure does not know (they are skipped with a warning, so the round trip loses them). `messages` names the messages of a file: its MSH-9 for a generated file, its 1-based position for an external file holding several messages (omitted for a one-message file). `reason` keys into `reasons`; `why` gives the specifics. A record nothing matches fails the test, so a fix that makes a message parse must remove its record.

reasons.choice-alternatives: hl7apy has no choice construct: where the standard allows one of OBR, RQD, RQ1, RXO, ODS and ODT as the order detail segment, the generated message carries all of them one after another, and the second one is out of place.
reasons.hl7apy-name: hl7apy's message list names the structure after an event the version does not have; the standard's name is in `why`.
reasons.hl7apy-structure: hl7apy's structure differs from the one the message ledger settled on (docs/validation/<version>-message-ledger.md: hl7.eu decides unless Caristix and HAPI agree against it); the generated message follows hl7apy's.
reasons.hapi-example: An example query profile that HAPI ships as a class and hl7apy lists as a message; not an event of the standard.
reasons.unsupported-version: MSH-12 names a version this package does not parse.
reasons.unknown-type: MSH-9 names no message type of the version.
reasons.nonconformant: The sample does not follow the standard's message table for its version (the ledger of that version confirms ours): a required segment is missing or a segment is out of place, as `why` says.
reasons.not-kept: parse() reads the message but encode() does not write it back the same; `lossy` says what is lost.

v2.3.min.hl7.why: v2.3 has ADR^A19 (the A19 response), EDR^R07 and ERP^R09 (the R07/R09 query responses) and RAS^O02 (pharmacy administration); see the v2.3 message ledger.

v2.3.min.hl7.error: MFN_M06 message must contain a CM0 segment
v2.3.min.hl7.why: hl7apy's v2.3 MFN_M06 carries a CDM charge description record (the standard's M04); Caristix and HAPI v23 give M06 the clinical study record { MFE CM0 [{CM1 [{CM2}]}] } (v2.3 message ledger MFN_M06).

v2.3.min.hl7.error: MFN_M09 message must contain an OM1 segment
v2.3.min.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v23, leaves out the OM1 that hl7.eu ch8 8.7 and Caristix require after MFE (v2.3 message ledger MFN_M09).

v2.3.min.hl7.error: MFN_M10 message must contain at least one MFE segment
v2.3.min.hl7.why: hl7apy makes the MFE group optional; hl7.eu ch8 8.7 and Caristix require at least one { MFE OM1 [ OM5 [{OM4}] ] } (v2.3 message ledger MFN_M10).

v2.3.min.hl7.error: RAR_RAR message must contain an RXR segment
v2.3.min.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v23, makes RXR optional after RXA; hl7.eu and Caristix require it (v2.3 message ledger RAR_RAR).

v2.3.full.hl7.why: v2.3 has ADR^A19 (the A19 response), EDR^R07 and ERP^R09 (the R07/R09 query responses) and RAS^O02 (pharmacy administration); see the v2.3 message ledger.

v2.3.full.hl7.error: MFN_M06 message must contain a CM0 segment
v2.3.full.hl7.why: hl7apy's v2.3 MFN_M06 carries a CDM charge description record (the standard's M04); Caristix and HAPI v23 give M06 the clinical study record { MFE CM0 [{CM1 [{CM2}]}] } (v2.3 message ledger MFN_M06).
hl7apy, like Caristix and HAPI v23, puts the M06 phase record (CM1) under M07; hl7.eu ch8 8.10 case 2 has { MFE CM0 [{CM2}] } (v2.3 message ledger MFN_M07).

v2.3.full.hl7.error: MFN_M09 message must contain an OM1 segment
v2.3.full.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v23, leaves out the OM1 that hl7.eu ch8 8.7 and Caristix require after MFE (v2.3 message ledger MFN_M09).

v2.3.full.hl7.error: MFN_M10 message must contain at least one MFE segment
v2.3.full.hl7.why: hl7apy makes the MFE group optional; hl7.eu ch8 8.7 and Caristix require at least one { MFE OM1 [ OM5 [{OM4}] ] } (v2.3 message ledger MFN_M10).

v2.3.full.hl7.error: RAR_RAR message must contain an RXR segment
v2.3.full.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v23, makes RXR optional after RXA; hl7.eu and Caristix require it (v2.3 message ledger RAR_RAR).

v2.3.1.min.hl7.error: MFN_M08 message must contain an OM1 segment
v2.3.1.min.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v231, makes OM1 optional; hl7.eu ch8 8.7 has { MFE OM1 [OM2] [OM3] [OM4] } (v2.3.1 message ledger MFN_M08).

v2.3.1.min.hl7.error: RDS_O01 message must contain at least one OBX segment
v2.3.1.min.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v231, makes the OBSERVATION group optional; hl7.eu ch4 4.8.9 has { OBX [{NTE}] } required (v2.3.1 message ledger RDS_O01).

v2.3.1.full.hl7.why: hl7apy puts a QAK after ERR; Caristix 2.3.1, the only source with a table for this event, has none (v2.3.1 message ledger MFR_M01).

v2.4.min.hl7.why: DFT^P11 is a v2.5 event; the v2.4 Caristix event list, which the v2.4 message ledger covers in full, does not have it.
K13 is the trigger of the RTB^K13 response to QBP^Q13; QBP_K13 is hl7apy's name for a query shaped like that response.

v2.4.full.hl7.why: DFT^P11 is a v2.5 event; the v2.4 Caristix event list, which the v2.4 message ledger covers in full, does not have it.
K13 is the trigger of the RTB^K13 response to QBP^Q13; QBP_K13 is hl7apy's name for a query shaped like that response.

v2.5.min.hl7.why: K13 is the trigger of the RTB^K13 response to QBP^Q13; QBP_K13 is hl7apy's name for a query shaped like that response.
Q11 is the trigger of the QBP^Q11 query; its response is RSP^K11.

v2.5.full.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v25, puts [{LCH}] between CDM and PRC; the 8.8 charge description record (Caristix 2.5, ours) has { MFE CDM [{PRC}] } (v2.5 message ledger MFR_M04).
K13 is the trigger of the RTB^K13 response to QBP^Q13; QBP_K13 is hl7apy's name for a query shaped like that response.
hl7apy, like HAPI v25, gives the v2.5 QRY^PC4 an SFT; hl7.eu ch12 and Caristix 2.5 do not (it appears in v2.5.1; v2.5 message ledger QRY_PC4).
hl7apy, like HAPI v25, fills the segment pattern of RSP^K11 with the tabular RDF [{RDT}]; hl7.eu ch5 and Caristix 2.5 leave it to the query profile (v2.5 message ledger RSP_K11).
hl7apy, like HAPI v25, repeats the QUERY_RESPONSE group; hl7.eu ch3 and Caristix 2.5 have it once (v2.5 message ledger RSP_K21).
Q11 is the trigger of the QBP^Q11 query; its response is RSP^K11.

v2.5.1.min.hl7.why: Q11 is the trigger of the QBP^Q11 query; its response is RSP^K11.

v2.5.1.full.hl7.why: hl7apy, like HAPI v251, fills the segment pattern of RSP^K11 with the tabular RDF [{RDT}]; hl7.eu ch5 and Caristix 2.5.1 leave it to the query profile (v2.5.1 message ledger RSP_K11).
Q11 is the trigger of the QBP^Q11 query; its response is RSP^K11.
